blocks.text: The inconvenience of dealing with clogged drains can disrupt the smooth functioning of any household. Clogged drains can lead to slow drainage or complete blockages, resulting in standing water in sinks, showers, or toilets. This not only hampers basic routines but it can also create an unpleasant and unhygienic environment.

Simple clogs caused by hair or soap residue can often be cleared using a plunger. However, certain clogs, such as those caused by debris, stubborn grease buildup, or deep blockages in the sewer line, require a licensed plumber. Professional plumbers have the knowledge and experience to accurately diagnose the cause of the clog and employ the most effective drain cleaning methods to clear it.

If you are dealing with a stubborn clogged drain in San Antonio, TX, the drain cleaning specialists at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air are ready to help. We have a team of expert plumbers who are extensively trained to resolve the most challenging clogs.
Professional Drain Cleaning in San Antonio
The licensed plumbers at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air have a range of techniques and tools at their disposal to unclog a drain. The method used depends on the severity and location of the clog.

One common method is using drain snakes or augers. These flexible tools are inserted into the drain to break up and remove the blockage. Plumbers manually rotate the snake to navigate through the pipes and dislodge debris.

Another approach to cleaning a drain is hydro jetting, which involves using high-pressure water to clear the clog. A specialized nozzle is inserted into the drain, forcefully spraying water to break up the blockage and flush it away. Hydro jetting is effective for stubborn clogs and cleaning the inside of the pipes.

In cases where the cause and location of the clog are not apparent, plumbers may use video camera inspections. A small camera is inserted into the drain, allowing the plumber to visually inspect the pipes and identify the exact source of the clog. This helps in providing targeted solutions and avoiding unnecessary damage.
We recommend avoiding DIY chemical drain cleaners. These cleaners contain powerful chemicals that can dissolve or break down the blockage, but can also damage your pipes.

Frequently Asked Questions About Drain Cleaning in San Antonio
What are the signs that I need professional drain cleaning?

Slow drainage, recurring clogs, standing water, unusual drain odors, and multiple fixtures draining poorly can indicate that professional drain cleaning is needed. A plumber can determine where the blockage is located and use the appropriate drain cleaning method to clear it.
When should I call a plumber for a clogged drain in San Antonio?

Call a plumber when a clogged drain does not clear, keeps returning, causes standing water, or affects multiple drains in your home. These problems can indicate a blockage deeper in the plumbing system that requires professional drain cleaning or drain clearing.
What methods are used for professional drain cleaning?

Professional drain cleaning methods can include drain snakes or augers, hydro jetting, and video camera inspections. The method used depends on the location, severity, and cause of the clog, allowing the plumber to choose the appropriate approach for clearing the drain.
What is the difference between drain cleaning and drain clearing?

Drain clearing focuses on removing a blockage so water can flow through the drain again, while drain cleaning can also address buildup and debris inside the pipe. A plumber can inspect the problem and determine which service is appropriate for the condition of the drain.
Can professional drain cleaning help with recurring clogged drains?

Yes. Recurring clogged drains can be caused by buildup, grease, debris, or a blockage deeper within the plumbing system. Professional drain cleaning can address the obstruction, while additional inspection may be recommended if the clog continues to return.
